biotools.summary: PoMeLo is a computational approach that identifies metabolic gaps in the genomes of pathogenic bacteria by leveraging a centralized database and allowing comparison across a large number of genomes. It generates tabular and visual outputs for users to compare predicted metabolic capacity.
